13783: Natsume Takashi is the main protagonist of the series who, like his deceased grandmother Natsume Reiko, has the ability to see ayakashi (spirits). He inherited the Book of Friends from her, a book of contracts binding ayakashi to servitude when they were defeated by Reiko.
13784: A mysterious feline spirit. Madara was sealed in a shrine until he was accidentally released by Natsume. Because Madara was trapped in a material form for so long, Madara ordinary takes on the shape of a maneki neko (lucky cat), leading Natsume to nickname him Nyanko-sensei.
13886: Reiko Natsume is the maternal grandmother of Takashi Natsume, and the person whom Takashi inherited his strong spiritual power from. She was despised by both humans and youkai. She was a bully towards humans and youkai alike, resulting in her being socially isolated.
13887: A man who is also able to see spirits. He is a famous actor and exorcist and has a lizard birthmark that moves around on his body. He has the ability to manipulate paper dolls and has three youkai under his command. Natsume tends to disapprove of his forceful exorcism methods.
13888: Another student who had recently moved into the area. He is sickly and quite susceptible to illnesses. Like Takashi Natsume, he is able to detect spirits, but to a lesser degree limited to seeing merely shadows and sensing slight presence of spirits.
14414: The class president of Takashi's class. Sasada believes that Takashi can see spirits, and constantly asks him questions about it, to which he replies that he doesn't have such an ability. Much to Takashi's chagrin, she wants to come along with him when he's visiting spirits.
15309: Hotaru is a spirit that has befriended a human that can no longer see her. She was originally a firefly turned into a Ayakashi by the mountain God as a reward. She falls in love with a Human.
15446: Really adorable kitsune child who befriends Natsume in the seventh episode of the first season, after being rescued from other yokai, who bullies him due to his gentle and shy nature.
15649: Swallow spirit, who wishes to meet a human that helped her before. Natsume agrees to help her and the two grow attached.
15650: Lord Mibu gathered performers to play in Isozuki's Forest. Asagi is a koto player serving Lord Mibu who contracted a sickness which caused her body to dry up and crumble to dust.
18630: He is a Lord of a forest. The Youkais that live in the forest often says that he's foolish for befriending humans because he liked them.
18790: A youkai guardian, partners with Sui.
19023: Hiiragi is a Yokai that has been forcibly tied to an old storehouse once owned by a prominent family. She was tied there with a rope she could not break and forced to curse anyone who tried opening it.
19209: Tama was found as a egg in Episode 4. Tama means eggy.
19455: Hinoe means third in rank, third sign of the Chinese calendar. A powerful youkai whose form is a human woman. She is madly in love with Natsume Reiko. Being knowledgeable, she often acts as Natsume Takashi's mentor. Hinoe enjoys teasing Natsume and Madara.
19456: A Youkai who, in the fifth episode, mistakes Natsume Takashi for Natsume Reiko and asks for his name back. Kirinoha's name isn't in the Book of Friends and as the episode progresses it seems that Reiko has played numerous amounts of pranks on him.
19515: Tohru Taki is a female student at Natsume's school. She was first "discovered" by one of Natsume's friends, Nishimura who had heard rumors of her beauty and became entranced, he still maintains an obvious crush on her even though Natsume holds most of her attention.
19546: The wife of Shigeru Fujiwara. In the past, she has offered Natsume Takashi to live with her and her husband. She said that she does not have any children. Touko is a very kind and loving housewife who treats Natsume as her own child, since she cares about him a lot.
19900: Sasafune is a mermaid that appeared in episode 8 when Takashi went to an inn with his male friends to study. She knew Chizu Sakanaka, the owner of the inn, when Chizu was small.
20126: He came from a wealthy family, yet he was frail. He often sat by a tree and read. He was found by a youkai, named Miya. They both spoke together since then. As the seasons went by, he did not came one day. Site: Episode 09 "The Man Amidst the Row of Cherry Blossoms".
20336: The husband of Touko Fujiwara. Along with Touko,Shigeru took Natsume over and he and his wife raise him as their own child. He is a quiet and considering man. When he was young, he met Natsume's grandmother, Reiko.
20815: A young boy who Natsume saves when he was locked in a coffin. He has a lot of friends and is a cheerful young boy.
23038: Natsume's friend from class. He is funny and easy-going, with a slightly perverted side. He has a crush on Taki Tooru, but thinks that she and Natsume are going out, and ran off comically crying.
23039: Natsume's friend from class. He is a sensible and rational person.
23041: The owner of the inn that Natsumi Takashi goes to in episode 8. It is told that while she was young, she came to like a person, known as Keiichi, who was around Takashi's age. However, Keiichi was sick.
23115: Youkai that first appears at episode 6 and 7 of Zoku Natsume Yuujinchou.
25272: A huge powerful bull youkai with many followers. He acknowledges that Natsume Takashi is a worthy holder of the Book of Friends and offers himself as Natsume's bodyguard in place of the "useless" Madara.
34355: A little girl that fell on a ledge and thought Madara was a pig
36536: Tsuyukami was one of the wandering spirits who sought residence in an old shrine. His powers tied to it, human prayer would give him strength.
40914: The catfish youkai that appear in episode 5.
43496: Urihime is one of the three faithful youkai under the command of Natori Shuuichi. She first appears with Sasago. In recent times, she is often seen appearing with Hiiragi under the command of Natori-san. All three of them have pledged their faithfulness to Natori-san.
44182: She first appears in Season 2 episode 11. She is an older member of the Matoba clan, acting as the current head's secretary and assistant.
44637: A kappa Natsume found lying dry on the ground. He helps the kappa by throwing water on him.
78999: A Shadow spirit that was captured by Reiko.
86255: A yokai who confronts Madara in episode 11, saying he's planning to take the book of friends from Natsume.
